name: sardrobe
description: Open-source AI digital wardrobe with local image processing, outfit planning, packing lists, WebMCP, and Cloudflare deployment.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm build-storybook && pnpm test:a11y && pnpm check:cloudflare
scripts.deploy:bootstrap: pnpm --filter @sardrobe/backend deploy && pnpm db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/frontend deploy
scripts.deploy: pnpm db:migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/backend deploy && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/frontend deploy
scripts.deploy:sardrobe:development: pnpm db:migrate:sardrobe:development && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/backend deploy:sardrobe:development && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/frontend deploy:sardrobe:development
scripts.deploy:sardrobe:production: pnpm db:migrate:sardrobe:production && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/backend deploy:sardrobe:production && pnpm --filter @sardrobe/frontend deploy:sardrobe:production
